paper_info.title: Engineering the RAG Stack: A Comprehensive Review of the Architecture and Trust Frameworks for Retrieval-Augmented Generation Systems
paper_info.authors: Dean Wampler, Dave Nielson, Alireza Seddighi
paper_info.paper_abstract: This article provides a comprehensive systematic literature review of academic studies, industrial applications, and real-world deployments from 2018 to 2025, providing a practical guide and detailed overview of modern Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) architectures. RAG offers a modular approach for integrating external knowledge without increasing the capacity of the model as LLM systems expand. Research and engineering practices have been fragmented as a result of the increasing diversity of RAG methodologies, which encompasses a variety of fusion mechanisms, retrieval strategies, and orchestration approaches. We provide quantitative assessment frameworks, analyze the implications for trust and alignment, and systematically consolidate existing RAG techniques into a unified taxonomy. This document is a practical framework for the deployment of resilient, secure, and domain-adaptable RAG systems, synthesizing insights from academic literature, industry reports, and technical implementation guides. It also functions as a technical reference.
paper_info.ai_abstract: 本文对2018至2025年间关于检索增强生成（RAG）系统的学术研究、工业应用和实际部署进行了系统性综述，旨在为现代RAG架构提供实用指南和全面概述。RAG通过模块化设计将外部知识引入大语言模型（LLM），避免了因模型扩容带来的成本与复杂性。然而，随着RAG方法在融合机制、检索策略和编排方式上的多样化，相关研究与工程实践日益碎片化。为此，作者提出了统一的RAG技术分类体系，构建了定量评估框架，并深入分析了RAG对可信性与模型对齐的影响。文章整合了来自学术界、产业界和技术实施文档的洞见，为构建具有韧性、安全性及领域适应性的RAG系统提供了实用框架和技术参考，特别关注法律、生物医学和合规等对准确性、时效性和可解释性要求高的应用场景。
